name: Research Synthetic Evaluation Dataset v1
description: 35 synthetic cybersecurity scenarios (55 raw events) across Wazuh, Suricata, Firewall, and Generic sources. Includes malicious, benign, suspicious, and edge-case events for fair comparison of five analysis architectures. Labels are manually assigned based on event content and are SYNTHETIC — not verified real-world incident outcomes.
